proposal.explanation: The primary failure at cycle 35 shows m_axis_tdata=0 when 1 is expected, indicating the output state machine isn't being triggered correctly. patch_f2d9d35bb697 adds a guard condition requiring m_axis_tready_int_reg for trigger activation, which directly controls whether STATE_OUTPUT_DATA is entered and data transmission begins. patch_bf3cb49329ff substitutes byte_count_next for offset initialization in the output state, correcting the byte-offset calculation that selects which statistic bytes to transmit. patch_d85c55cc2e00 replaces frame_count_reg reset with loop index i, fixing the frame counter update that affects multi-frame accounting. patch_75435d38326c initializes m_axis_tready_int_reg with m_axis_tvalid_int instead of 1'b0, ensuring the ready-int signal reflects actual output validity. patch_a22fdc889d1f sets temp_m_axis_tuser_reg to m_axis_tready, correcting the user signal propagation in the output pipeline. patch_de6f8c13a145 uses busy_reg for frame_next, linking frame state to the busy indicator. patch_489a6092dfdc substitutes loop index i for frame_count_next initialization. patch_a7d16ae94182 assigns m_axis_tvalid_reg to temp_m_axis_tlast_reg, fixing last-signal handling in the temp register path.
